title: JSON Patch Operation
description: JSON Patch operation which contains the generated text and the JSON Pointer to apply it.

path.title: Path
path.description: The JSON Pointer to apply this new value to on a given JSON document. The path points to which specific property on which particular component is being changed.

value.title: Value
value.description: The complete raw text of the generated draft content. Includes the entire contents of a property. For example, includes HTML tags if they’re present in the content.

type.title: Data Type
type.description: The underlying data type of the generated text. For example, lightning__richTextType, lightning__textType.

op.title: Operation
op.description: The operation is “add” if the value is new, or “replace” if an existing value is being updated.
